aspect: Somatic presentation is the norm, not an alternative
description: In the 2026 Halabja study, severe somatic symptoms accompanied 79% PTSD and 65% depression/anxiety rates. The lead researcher noted headaches, back pain and exhaustion often express psychological wounds directly.
energy_note: The pain is real and the cause is not in the joint.

aspect: Which means years of the wrong investigations
description: The patient presents with chest pain and gets a cardiac workup. Then a gastric one. Then a neurological one. Each is negative, each costs money and months, and each reinforces the sense of not being believed.
energy_note: Investigated repeatedly and told there is nothing wrong.

aspect: HPA-axis dysregulation is the common mechanism
description: Sustained glucocorticoid signalling changes - the same system implicated in FKBP5 and NR3C1 findings in survivor cohorts - link the psychological to the metabolic and immune.
energy_note: One broken thermostat, wired to everything.
source_name: Yehuda et al., Biological Psychiatry 2015 / AJP 2020

aspect: SECONDARY - it lands in the decade you were going to earn in
description: The cardiac event at 52, the disability at 57. The years removed are the peak-earning, pension-building ones, so the financial consequence is disproportionate to the medical one.
energy_note: The war collects in your fifties.
